plan.summary: Build an in-memory notes web app with a JSON HTTP API and a responsive mobile-friendly HTML frontend using Python standard library http.server.
plan.deliverable: A complete Python web application under app/ with server and static assets, unit tests under tests/, and acceptance tests under qa_tests/.
plan.interface_contract: app.server.make_server(port=0) returns an http.server.HTTPServer instance. HTTP endpoints: GET / returns HTML index page, GET /notes returns JSON list of notes, POST /notes accepts JSON body {"title": str, "content": str} and returns 201 Created with JSON note, GET /notes/<id> returns 207/200 JSON note or 404, PUT /notes/<id> updates note, DELETE /notes/<id> deletes note. Title must be 1-200 chars.

tasks.title: Write acceptance tests
tasks.instructions: Write independent pytest acceptance tests in qa_tests/ test_notes.py covering API endpoints, validation rules for title length (1-200 chars), and HTML interface existence based on the objective.

tasks.title: Implement notes web application
tasks.instructions: Implement the in-memory notes store, validation logic, http.server handlers in app/server.py, and the HTML frontend in app/static/index.html or embedded. Also write unit tests under tests/test_app.py.

tasks.title: Review codebase and tests
tasks.instructions: Review all files under app/, tests/, and qa_tests/ for correctness, standard library compliance, and edge cases, reporting any defects.
